label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterValues directly constructs fileName which is passed to FileOutputStream constructor via FileInputStream.getFD(), enabling potential SSRFI/Path Traversal via arbitrary file descriptor manipulation. While ESAPI encoder mitigates XSS in the printout, the underlying file operation remains vulnerable to remote code execution or system compromise through maliciously crafted filenames.

evidence.note: User input flows to fileName used in FileOutputStream constructor creating insecure file access vector
